component.name: Iris
component.summary: A browser made of glass, with shields built in

description.p: Iris is a browser written in Swift with libadwaita. Its pages are drawn by WebKitGTK, and its interface is Liquid Glass: clear glass that bends what is behind it, drawn by GTK itself and sharp at every display scale.

ul.li: Iris Shields: about 100,000 ad and tracker domains blocked inside the engine, and the pop-ups ads open
Containers: worlds apart, each with its own cookies, storage and sign-ins, and private tabs
A menu of glass on a right click, a downloads panel, find in page
A translucent window that the compositor blurs where it can (niri and others)
Every search answered by Google AI Mode from high-quality, current sources
